common.fGn: Davies-Harte circulant embedding, size 2n, conjugate-symmetric complex normals, exact; validated (validation.out, 0 fails)
common.seed_scheme: SeedSequence(entropy=seed, spawn_key=(family 0 khom/1 dml, cell_idx, rep))
common.reps: pilot 20/cell (not evidence); main 2000/cell, fallback 1000 at largest n/T if projection > 48 CPU-h

K-hom.processes: G1 fGn; G2 2Phi(xi)-1; G3 sign(xi); R1 Euler fOU Y_t=(1-lam)Y_{t-1}+g_t, g fGn H=0.1, lam in {0.01,0.1}, Y_0=0, burn-in ceil(10/lam)
K-hom.statistic: V-statistic MMD^2, first n/2 vs last n/2; Gaussian kernel exp(-d^2/(2 sigma^2)); sigma = median nonzero |x_i-x_j| over i<j (zeros excluded so G3 has a bandwidth)
K-hom.wild_bootstrap: Chwialkowski-Sejdinovic-Gretton 2014 two-sample form; one Rademacher block-Markov chain over the whole series (keep previous with prob exp(-1/l), else fresh Rademacher; corr exp(-k/l)), l=floor(n^0.5), centred within each half, B=500, p=(1+#{boot>=stat})/(B+1), reject p<=0.05
K-hom.subsampling: Betken-Dehling sampling window: l=floor(n^0.5), all n-l+1 windows, window stat l*MMD^2(first floor(l/2) vs rest) with full-sample bandwidth, reject if n*MMD^2 > ceil(0.95 m)-th order statistic; d_n not applicable to a one-series test
K-hom.power_check: G1 H=0.7, second half shifted by +0.3, all n, 2000 reps (same rule as null cells)

DML.dgp: X fGn (G1) H grid; D~Bern(expit(0.5X)); Y=tau(X)D+X+eps, eps iid N(0,1); tau const=1, rank1=1+X, rank2=1+(X^2-1)
DML.estimands: population ATE=1; path-conditional mean_t tau(X_t); same interval scored against both

arms.oracle: known propensity + true outcome regressions (isolates state term + MDS)
arms.kp_iid/kp_blk: known propensity + GB outcome regressions, 5-fold cross-fit
arms.lrn_iid/lrn_blk: logistic IRLS propensity + GB outcome regressions, 5-fold cross-fit

DML.interpretation_note: design says 'learned (logistic + gradient boosting)': read as logistic for propensity, GB for outcome regressions mu0, mu1 (fit on control/treated units of the training fold). The known-propensity arm is reported both with oracle and with GB outcome regressions; KC4 judged on oracle and reported for kp_* too.
DML.folds: iid: random permutation into 5 folds; blocked: 5 contiguous blocks, training excludes points within b=floor(T^0.5) of the held-out block
DML.GB: numpy histogram gradient boosting, squared loss, 255 quantile bins of training-fold state, depth-2 trees split on bin edges, min_samples_leaf 20, learning_rate 0.1, 100 rounds, init = mean (sklearn absent; implemented locally)
DML.IRLS: features [1,x], <=50 Newton steps, converged if max|step|<1e-8; nonconvergence counted and reported; learned propensity clipped to [0.01,0.99], clip count reported
DML.variance: NW Bartlett with Andrews 1991 AR(1) plug-in S=1.1447(alpha T)^{1/3}, rho clipped to +-0.97, weights 1-j/(S+1), j<=floor(S), normal crit; EWC (LLSW 2018) nu=floor(0.4 T^{2/3}), t_nu crit
DML.power_check: rejection of theta0=1.1 at H=0.7, tau const, from the same reps

analysis.primary: size or coverage minus nominal, Wilson 95% MC interval per cell
analysis.breakpoint: per family/calibration: hockey-stick excess = a + c*(H-kappa)_+, kappa on grid [0.5,0.9] step 0.001 by profile LS at the largest n/T; 95% CI by parametric binomial bootstrap of cell rates (2000 draws); 'follows line' = CI contains prediction (0.5 rank-1, 0.75 rank-2) and excess grows with n only beyond it

kill_criteria.KC3: pop-ATE NW coverage, tau rank1, H=0.9, T=8000 >= 93% -> C1 killed (judged on oracle; all arms reported)
kill_criteria.KC4: path-conditional coverage < 93% at H=0.9 with known propensity -> stop and diagnose

change: replications at n=4000 reduced from 2000 to 1000 (design fallback rule); n in {500,1000,2000} keep 2000
reason: timing pilot (20 reps/cell, pilot/khom) projects 52.2 CPU-h for 2000 reps everywhere, above the 48 CPU-h cap
DML: no change: projection 12.4 CPU-h for 2000 reps in all 54 cells (s/rep 0.387, 0.426, 0.428 at T=500, 2000, 8000)
pilot_note: first pilot (kept in pilot_v1_blas_multithread/, not used) mis-timed because run.py imported numpy before the single-thread BLAS env vars were set; run.py fixed (env set before numpy import) and the pilot re-run. No statistical parameter changed.

verdicts.P2: confirmed in substance; strict knot-CI test contains 0.5 in 3/6 MMD fits, 0/10 DML fits (knot 0.50-0.56, between grid points)
verdicts.P3: holds for H<=0.7 and H>=0.8; at H=0.75 deficit 6.7pp NW / 3.3-4.3pp EWC, so strict wording fails at the boundary point
verdicts.KC3: not triggered (pop coverage 11.95% oracle NW) - C1 survives
verdicts.KC4: not triggered (min path coverage at H=0.9, known propensity 94.4%)
